knowledge.title: What services do you provide? Services overview
knowledge.content: The Tech Principle works across four connected disciplines: Web design and rebuilds; AI site assistants; Local SEO and lead generation; and Trading and data products. We can help you decide which is the right starting point for your business.

knowledge.title: Tell me about your business. About The Tech Principle
knowledge.content: The Tech Principle is an independent technology studio in London. We diagnose what is not working, build the right solution in the open, then prove the outcome with evidence. The focus is hand-built systems that you own, with technology chosen only when it earns its place.

knowledge.title: How much do your services cost? Pricing guide
knowledge.content: We scope each project around the work required rather than sell fixed packages or invent a price before understanding the brief. Email edward.bell@thetechprinciple.com with what you need and we will provide a clear estimate.

knowledge.title: I would like a quote. Start a project
knowledge.content: To start a project, tell us what you are trying to achieve, what you have today, and any deadline or constraints. The enquiry form can capture the essentials and we will come back with the appropriate next step.

knowledge.title: Web design and rebuilds
knowledge.content: Bespoke sites for businesses that have outgrown a template, and rescue work for ones stuck on something a decade old. Hand-built, fast, and owned by you: design systems rather than one-off page layouts, sub-second loads on hand-written HTML and CSS, accessible by default (semantics, contrast, focus states), and legacy migration with content and rankings preserved. What we build toward: a site you own outright, built to load fast and turn more of your visitors into enquiries.

knowledge.title: AI site assistants
knowledge.content: A trained assistant that lives on your site, answers real questions in your voice, books the job, and tells your team when a lead has gone cold instead of letting it die. Grounded in your actual services, prices and hours; lead capture with automatic follow-up on non-converters; an admin dashboard with recovered-revenue reporting; modular, so capabilities switch on per client. What we build toward: enquiries answered at 11pm, and a dashboard that puts a figure on what follow-up brought back.

knowledge.title: Local SEO and lead generation
knowledge.content: Being findable in the ten miles that actually matter. Technical SEO, structured data and Core Web Vitals; local pack positioning and review infrastructure; AI-native discovery built to be cited, not just crawled; automated prospect discovery and qualification. What we build toward: a steady inbound line instead of a monthly scramble for the next job.

knowledge.title: Trading and data products
knowledge.content: Live market data pipelines, strategy execution engines, backtest-to-live parity auditing, and the analytics layer that makes any of it trustworthy. Real-time ingestion and multi-asset price collection; strategy execution with full audit trails; backtest and live parity verification; analytics dashboards over SQL and PostgreSQL. What we build toward: systems that keep their promises after the demo is over.

knowledge.title: Small business site programme
knowledge.content: Forty-four hand-built sites moving through the deployment pipeline: garages, salons, nail bars, trades and taxi firms, each a bespoke design system rather than a reskinned template.

knowledge.title: Salon and barbering rebuilds
knowledge.content: Eleven legacy hair and beauty sites taken from dated, unresponsive builds to modern, bookable storefronts, with the original content and search equity intact.

knowledge.title: Website assistant framework
knowledge.content: A multi-tenant assistant platform with per-client modules, lead capture, cold-lead follow-up and an ROI dashboard that puts a number on the revenue it recovered.

knowledge.title: Autonomous signal platform
knowledge.content: End-to-end market data ingestion, strategy selection and execution, with parity auditing between backtest and live so the numbers survive contact with reality.

knowledge.title: Lead generation engine
knowledge.content: Automated business discovery, qualification and outreach: identifying companies running dated sites and putting a working preview in front of them.

knowledge.title: Analytics and insight tooling
knowledge.content: Dashboards and reporting surfaces over live trading data: performance views, strategy comparison, and the audit kits that make results defensible.

knowledge.title: How we work: diagnose, build, prove
knowledge.content: Diagnose: we look at what you have, what it costs you, and what it's failing to do, including when the honest answer is that you don't need us. Build: hand-built, in the open, with something to look at early, no six-week silence followed by a reveal. Prove: shipped with the instrumentation to show whether it worked, load times, enquiries, conversions, recovered leads, evidence not assurances.

knowledge.title: The Tech Principle: technology should earn its place
knowledge.content: Every choice on a project has to justify itself against a simpler alternative, and most of the time the simpler thing wins. Build it, don't assemble it: hand-written code understood end to end, instead of a stack of plugins nobody can debug at 2am. Evidence over assertion: if we say it's faster, there's a number; if we say it converts, there's a dashboard showing it. You own the outcome: your code, your data, your accounts, no hostage-taking, no proprietary lock-in, no rental model on your own site. Say no to the wrong work: we turn down projects we can't do well.

knowledge.title: How to get in touch
knowledge.content: Email edward.bell@thetechprinciple.com to start a project or ask a question. There is no published phone number or office address yet.
